title: Encode DAO D flag consistently with optional DODAGID
description: rust/lichen-rpl/src/message.rs Dao::write_to sizes the base header as 4 bytes when dodag_id is None but unconditionally sets the DAO D flag. It therefore emits a four-byte DAO claiming a 16-byte DODAGID is present, which the parser rejects as truncated and peers cannot decode. Set D only when the DODAGID is serialized (while retaining the global-instance requirement) and add writer/parser round trips for D=0 and D=1.
